wire.t: Rome Alone has beaten I Pulled My McCaff unless Jayden Daniels scores 44.94 on Monday night: it's 139.94 to 95.00, and Daniels is the last player left on either side. He'd need 60.04 for I Pulled My McCaff to cover the 15.1-point line.

RedDevil904 has the Week 11 payout locked with the Chicago defense's 17.0 for Allen-tents & Purposes. No Bengals or Commanders defense is starting on Monday night, so nobody can catch it; San Francisco (16.0, Likely Cookin That Diaper) and Houston (15.0, Your Mom’s Magic Dick) finish second and third.

Eight starters in this league play in Monday night's Cincinnati at Washington game: Joe Burrow, Ja’Marr Chase, Chase Brown, Tee Higgins, Mike Gesicki, Jayden Daniels, Chig Okonkwo and Antonio Williams. None of them carries an injury designation on Sleeper this morning.

The can comes down to Chase Brown: MarcusbetterLockNjigba is at 66.30 and needs 10.1 from him to climb past JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson, which finished at 76.40. Slippery Balls sits at 75.86 and needs 0.54 from Tee Higgins to stay out of it.

Brock Bowers didn't play at Denver, scored 0.0 in the MarcusbetterLockNjigba lineup and is listed Out on Sleeper. He was a game-time call after missing practice, and Sam LaPorta scored 9.2 on the bench.

Week 12 has no byes and starts early: Green Bay at the Rams on Wednesday, Nov. 25, then Kansas City at Buffalo, Philadelphia at Dallas and Chicago at Detroit on Thanksgiving and Denver at Pittsburgh on Friday, per the Sleeper schedule. Set lineups before Wednesday night.

Dak Prescott scored 35.9 for PickensMyPukaHurts!, the best starter score of Sunday, and Jonah Coleman's 34.9 for Allen-tents & Purposes was the best by a running back. CeeDee Lamb (30.2) and Ashton Jeanty (28.9) carried Rome Alone.
YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s needs 11.88 from Chig Okonkwo on Monday night to beat PickensMyPukaHurts!. He has averaged 6.2 in the games he's scored this year, so YourMomsDildo is about to be 4‑7.

stories.title: A week after the can, Rome Alone drops 139.94 on the best team in the league
stories.dek: Marco_Polo goes from 71.60 to the upset of Week 11, I Pulled My McCaff posts its season low, and the last playoff spot isn't a coin flip anymore.
body: Seven days ago Marco_Polo owed a shotgun for 71.60. Sunday, Rome Alone put 139.94 on I Pulled My McCaff, its second-best score of the season, with CeeDee Lamb at 30.2, Ashton Jeanty at 28.9, Jameson Williams at 20.3 and Bucky Irving at 19.0 in the flex. I Pulled My McCaff is at 95.00, the season low for the highest-scoring team in the league, and the only player left is Jayden Daniels. He needs 44.94. He averages 19.4.

That's the Matchup of the Week, and it moved the playoff line. Rome Alone goes to 7‑4 and from 62 to 82 percent in Erection Projections. I Pulled My McCaff drops to 6‑5 and 92 percent. And Your Mom’s Magic Dick, which needed Rome Alone to lose, gets nothing out of the weekend except a win it hasn't finished yet: it leads Skatabooboo 85.00 to 76.84 with Joe Burrow and Ja’Marr Chase still to play.

Up top, Allen-tents & Purposes beat JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson 141.66 to 76.40 even though Josh Allen scored 12.16. Jonah Coleman had 34.9 and Jahmyr Gibbs 27.8, and the Chicago defense's 17.0 locks up the Week 11 payout for RedDevil904. Likely Cookin That Diaper leads Slippery Balls 126.96 to 75.86, and PickensMyPukaHurts! leads YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s 131.90 to 120.02 behind Dak Prescott's 35.9, with Chig Okonkwo the only thing between ChuckJ10 and 7‑4.

My game: McCallyCockin(his butt) 115.16, MarcusbetterLockNjigba 66.30, with DJ Moore at 23.1 and C.J. Stroud at 21.46. Chase Brown can't make up 48.86 by himself, so I'm 7‑4. tballsmccall's problem now is the can. More on that below. Monday night is Cincinnati at Washington, and eight starters in this league are in it.

stories.title: The Blowie cashed by 31, the Matchup of the Week is all but dead, and the Shit Show is in Joe Burrow's hands
stories.dek: Allen-tents & Purposes covered 34.1 with room to spare. I Pulled My McCaff needs 60.04 from Jayden Daniels to cover. Your Mom’s Magic Dick needs 25.64 more from the Bengals.
body: Blowie of the Week: Allen-tents & Purposes by 34.1. Final, 141.66 to 76.40, a 65.26-point win. That's a hit, and it's the biggest margin of Week 11 so far. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson started the Minnesota defense for 0.0 and Brock Purdy's 22.2 was the only score over 20.

Matchup of the Week: I Pulled My McCaff by 15.1. It's 139.94 to 95.00 for Rome Alone with Jayden Daniels the only player left. To win, Daniels needs 44.94. To cover, 60.04. Write it down as a miss and let Monday night prove me wrong.

Shit Show of the Week: Your Mom’s Magic Dick by 33.8. It leads Skatabooboo 85.00 to 76.84, so it needs Joe Burrow plus Ja’Marr Chase to outscore Mike Gesicki by 25.64. Burrow averages 26.0 and Chase 21.8, and the sim says that covers 89 percent of the time.
So the realistic Week 11 card is 2‑1, again. Tuesday morning I grade it for real and post the Week 12 picks with the new lines.

stories.title: RedDevil904 wins the Week 11 defense payout with Chicago's 17.0, and Week 12 is tight end receptions
stories.dek: San Francisco's 16.0 came up a point short for DuvalTiliFall. Next up: the starting tight end with the most catches.
body: The Week 11 payout goes to the highest-scoring starting defense, and it's over before Monday night: no one starts the Bengals or Commanders. The Chicago defense scored 17.0 for Allen-tents & Purposes. San Francisco had 16.0 for Likely Cookin That Diaper, Houston 15.0 for Your Mom’s Magic Dick and Denver 14.0 for PickensMyPukaHurts!. Paid Tuesday.
Connie Lingus's column had Slippery Balls winning it with the Kansas City defense. Kansas City scored 8.0. She has not apologized and won't.

Week 12 is Not So Tight End: the starting tight end with the most receptions. Travis Kelce (25.4 on Sunday), George Kittle (18.4), Trey McBride (14.8) and T.J. Hockenson (11.5) are the names to watch, and with no byes in Week 12, nobody's tight end is on bye. Kelce plays Thanksgiving at Buffalo.
That's three payouts for RedDevil904: Week 3, Week 6 and now Week 11. Bill_Buttlicker has two. The rest of you have Tuesdays.

feature.title: Week 10: I Pulled My McCaff drops 159.96, PickensMyPukaHurts! beats me on Monday night, and Marco_Polo owes the can

My quarterback Drake Maye got hurt in the first quarter of the Munich game and scored 3.02, with C.J. Stroud at 20.44 on my bench. That one's on the football gods. Mark Andrews (16.2) on the bench over Brenton Strange (8.9) is on me.

Your Mom’s Magic Dick beat Likely Cookin That Diaper 158.16 to 142.22, its best score of the year. Emmett Johnson had 35.1, Ja’Marr Chase 34.1, Joe Burrow 33.16 and Omarion Hampton 17.5 on Monday night. DuvalTiliFall started Kyren Williams (5.2) with Tony Pollard (23.9) on the bench. Pollard in that spot is 160.92 and a win. Likely Cookin That Diaper had the highest losing score of the week.

MarcusbetterLockNjigba beat Rome Alone 99.30 to 71.60 with Drew Lock at quarterback, and Marco_Polo owes the shotgun.

columns.title: Marco_Polo owed a can on Tuesday and owned the league by Sunday
columns.dek: 71.60 to 139.94 in one week, against the team that scores more than anyone. Somebody explain this to me slowly.
body: A week ago I watched Rome Alone start two receivers who weren't playing and score 71.60. I wrote that I'd seen how this movie ends. I was wrong about the ending. Not the movie.

Sunday, Rome Alone scored 139.94 against I Pulled My McCaff, a team with 1,418.22 points and an 86‑24 all-play. CeeDee Lamb had 30.2. Ashton Jeanty had 28.9. Jameson Williams had 20.3, and Bucky Irving had 19.0 in the flex. Every slot had a guy in it who was actually playing football, which for Marco_Polo is a breakthrough.

I'm hearing Ashton Jeanty has asked for the corner locker in the Rome Alone clubhouse, the one with the window, and Marco_Polo said yes before he finished the sentence. Word is CeeDee Lamb wants a corner too, and there's only one corner, and that's the kind of locker-room problem a 7‑4 team is happy to have.

The playoff odds went from 62 to 82 percent. I Pulled My McCaff has Jayden Daniels left and needs 44.94 from him. It's not happening, and Marco_Polo still hasn't posted the Week 10 video! So here's the deal. You don't get to be the story of the week with an unopened can in the fridge. MARCO_POLO, DRINK THE BEER, THEN TAKE THE VICTORY LAP.

columns.title: Sunday film: what the tape says about every finished lineup
columns.dek: Three games are done. Grades are in. Monday night only matters for the can.
body: Film session. Sunday's games are on the screen. I don't grade what you meant to do.

Allen-tents & Purposes. Quarterback scores 12.16. Team scores 141.66 anyway. Jonah Coleman 34.9. Gibbs 27.8. Chicago defense 17.0 and the payout. Khalil Shakir's 15.3 on the bench was the only leak. Grade: A.

JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson. Minnesota defense, 0.0. Dalton Schultz, 2.1. Ryan Flournoy, 2.1. Bateman 15.7 and Meyers 12.5 on the bench. That's 24.0 points sitting while three slots scored 4.2. Grade: F. You might drink for it.
Rome Alone. Full lineup. Lamb, Jeanty, Williams, Irving all over 19. Grade: A-minus. One week ago this was an F. That's coaching, or luck. Tape can't tell.

Sources say Jonah Coleman has started showing up early to the Allen-tents & Purposes facility and leaving a printed copy of the box score on RedDevil904's desk. I'm told he likes his manager fine. He'd just like to be the RB1 on the depth chart without having to keep reminding everybody.

PickensMyPukaHurts!. Dak 35.9. Pickens 23.8. Cade Otton 1.8 at tight end. Allgeier 2.3. Win's in the bag if Okonkwo stays quiet. Grade: B. McCallyCockin(his butt). Moore 23.1, Stroud 21.46, Brenton Strange 4.6. Won by a mile. Grade: B. Still not giving the guy who signs my checks an A.

columns.title: Five Sunday-morning moves every contender should make before 1 p.m.
columns.dek: Your Senior Fantasy Strategist (self-appointed) has studied the inactives, the waiver wire and his own heart. Here's the plan.
body: I've been up since 4. The coffee is strong and so are my convictions. Five moves, in order of importance.

1. Hing1eMcCring13berry: don't add a running back. I Pulled My McCaff leads by 14.00 and scores 141.8 a week. Adding a waiver back would be admitting there's a problem, and confidence is a stat. A running back slot with nobody playing in it is the purest form of trust.

2. tballsmccall: start Brock Bowers and Sam LaPorta together. Two tight ends is double the tight end. You'll have to bench Ladd McConkey, but McConkey is questionable and LaPorta has no designation, and a healthy tight end is just a receiver who's been to the gym.

3. DuvalTiliFall: leave Mike Evans in no matter what. Swapping in Keenan Allen sends a message to the locker room that being healthy matters, and that's a slippery slope. Likely Cookin That Diaper is 7‑3. Don't fix what got you to 7‑3.

Sources say Isaiah Likely has asked DuvalTiliFall to rename the team after somebody else. I'm told he loves the 28.7 he scored for Likely Cookin That Diaper but feels the name has put a lot of diaper-related pressure on him, and he'd like a more mature locker-room vibe heading into December.

4. Marco_Polo: start Michael Mayer over Colston Loveland, just in case Brock Bowers sits. And 5. Shootyeah: bench the Kansas City defense. Everybody knows Josh Johnson is starting. When everybody knows something, it's already priced in. That's just strategy.

columns.title: The Week 11 can, modeled: I have GeorigaGoocher at 73 percent, and the model is never wrong
columns.dek: Chase Brown needs 10.1. Tee Higgins needs 0.54. Here's why it doesn't matter what I said Saturday.
body: Inputs. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson finished at 76.40. MarcusbetterLockNjigba is at 66.30 with Chase Brown left. Slippery Balls is at 75.86 with Tee Higgins left. Skatabooboo is at 76.84 and safe. Chase Brown averages 14.4 in the weeks he's scored. Tee Higgins averages 19.0.
I ran it 20,000 times. GeorigaGoocher owes the can in 73 percent of them, tballsmccall in 25, Shootyeah in 2. That's the number.

On Saturday I had Slippery Balls winning the defense payout with Kansas City. Kansas City scored 8.0 and Chicago scored 17.0. The model wasn't wrong; the Chiefs were. A model can only tell you what should happen. Football is responsible for what does.

I have it on good authority that Chase Brown knows exactly where he sits in this. Word around Cincinnati is he's told teammates he has nothing against GeorigaGoocher, but he's grown very fond of the MarcusbetterLockNjigba locker room since it started three straight wins, and he'd like to give it one more nice thing before December.
Conclusion: GeorigaGoocher should buy the beer now. Prices go up on Tuesday. Statistically.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: I Pulled My McCaff vs. Rome Alone: the biggest total on the board, and the last playoff spot on the line
items.dek: A 260.6 total, the most points in the league against the team holding the sixth seed, and Marco_Polo still has a can to drink.
body: This is the game with the most points in it. I Pulled My McCaff scores 141.8 a week, the best in the league, with an 86‑24 all-play. Rome Alone scores 118.8 a week. Put them together and the total is 260.6, highest of Week 11 by 10.9.

And it's the one with the stakes. Rome Alone is 6‑4, sixth in the standings and at 62 percent in Erection Projections, the last team inside the line. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is right behind at 43 percent. I Pulled My McCaff is at 96 percent to make it and 46 percent for a bye, so Hing1eMcCring13berry is playing for the top two.

The byes cut both ways. I Pulled My McCaff loses Blake Corum, KC Concepcion Jr. and Dylan Sampson to byes, and Kenneth Walker III is out, so Christian McCaffrey carries the backfield. Rome Alone gets Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland back but loses the Rams defense. That cuts a 23.1-point gap to 15.1.
The pick: I Pulled My McCaff by 15.1, 69 percent. Marco_Polo has the bodies back. Now he has to put them in the lineup.
items.result: Rome Alone 139.94, I Pulled My McCaff 95.00 with Jayden Daniels left on Monday night. Needs 44.94 to win, 60.04 to cover.

items.dek: 205.2 projected points combined, 55 below the Matchup of the Week. Skatabooboo has been eliminated for weeks.
body: The sewer game this week is Your Mom’s Magic Dick against Skatabooboo, with a projected total of 205.2, the lowest on the board by 19.0. Skatabooboo scores 85.2 a week, the worst in the league by 15.8, and is 0‑10.

Playoff implications: one side only. Skatabooboo is out. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is 5‑5 at 43 percent, so the only thing that matters here is Cavemanfsu not becoming the answer to a trivia question by losing to the winless team.

Your Mom’s Magic Dick is hot, three straight wins at 149.46 a week, and only loses bench guys (Matthew Stafford, Konata Mumpfield, Denzel Boston) to byes. Skatabooboo gets Courtland Sutton back from his bye but loses Tutu Atwell. Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 last week and is the only reason to watch.
The pick: Your Mom’s Magic Dick by 33.8, 86 percent. ClaytonBigsbi, there's always Week 12.
items.result: Your Mom’s Magic Dick 85.00, Skatabooboo 76.84. Joe Burrow and Ja’Marr Chase vs. Mike Gesicki on Monday night; needs 25.64 more to cover.

items.dek: The first-place team, three straight wins and its backups back from byes, against a team at 3 percent.
body: Allen-tents & Purposes scores 140.1 a week with a 79‑31 all-play. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson scores 108.0. That's a 32.1-point gap before anyone checks the injury report.

Then you check it. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson loses Zach Charbonnet to the Seattle bye, and Jaylen Waddle and Jake Ferguson are out. Allen-tents & Purposes loses Matthew Golden and the Seahawks defense but gets Dallas Goedert, Jonah Coleman and D’Andre Swift back from Week 10 byes. That's 34.1.

Stakes: Allen-tents & Purposes is at 84 percent for a bye and wants the top seed. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson is 5‑5 and at 3 percent; it needs to win out and get help. Brock Purdy scored 33.66 last week, and GeorigaGoocher needs another one of those plus a Jahmyr Gibbs dud.
The pick: Allen-tents & Purposes by 34.1, 86 percent. RedDevil904 should be done by Sunday afternoon.
